entries.def:
Ἰκόνιον, -ου, τό 
Iconium, a city of the province of Galatia: Act.13.51; 14.1, 19; 14.21; 16.2, 2Ti.3.11.†
(AS)

ἱλαρός, -ά, -όν
(ἵλαος = ἵλεως, which see), [in LXX: Pro.19.12 (רָצוֹן) Pro.22.8, Est.5.1, Job.33.26, Sir.13.26; 26.4, 3Ma.6.35 * ;] 
cheerful, joyous: 2Co.9.7 (Pro.22.8" (LXX) )†
(AS)

ἱλαρότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἱλαρός), [in LXX: Pro.18.22 (רָצוֹן)* ;] 
cheerfulness: Rom.12.8.†
(AS)

ἱλάσκομαι
(ἵλαος = ἵλεως) [in LXX (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 85 f.) for סָלַח, 4Ki.5.18 24:4, Psa.25.11, Lam.3.42, Da TH Dan.9.19 כָּפַר pi., Psa.65.3; 78.38; 79.9; נָחַם ni., Exo.32.14, Est.4.17 * ;] 
__1. in cl., with accusative of person(s), to conciliate, appease, propitiate (= ἐξιλάσκομαι, Gen.32.20, Pro.16.14, Mal.1.9, al.). 
__2. In LXX (Thackeray, Gr., 270, 1.), Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 224 f.), and NT, to be…

ἱλασμός, -οῦ
(ἱλάσκομαι), [in LXX: Lev.25.9, Num.5.8 (כִּפֻּר), Psa.130.4, Da TH Dan.9.9 (סְלִיחָה), Amo.8.14 (אַשְׁמָה), Ezk.44.27 (חַטָּאָה), 1Ch.28.20, Sir.18.20 A, 2Ma.3.33 * ;] 
__1. an appeasing (Plut.). 
__2. a means of appeasing, propitiation (Philo; Nu, Ez, ll.with): 1Jn.2.2 Jhn.4.10. 
__3. In LXX also forgiveness (Ps, Da TH, ll.with).†
(AS)

ἱλαστήριος, -α, -ον
(ἱλάσκομαι), [in LXX: 4Ma.17.22 neut., Exo.25.16 (17) ff. Exo.31.7; 35.12; 37.6 ff., Lev.16.2, 13 ff. Num.7.89 (כַּפֹּרֶת), Ezk.43.14, 17; 43.20 (עֲזָרָה) Amo.9.1 (on the original here, see Deiss., BS, 127)* ;] 
propitiatory (μνῆμα, FlJ, Ant., xvi, 7, 1; θάνατος, 2Mac, l.with): of Christ, Rom.3.25 as subst., το ἱ. (sc. ἐπίθεμα, Exo.25.16-17, where the word first occurs in LXX and where ἱ. ἐ. =…

ἵλεως, -ων
(Att.. for ἵλαος), [in LXX for חָלִיל, 1Ki.14.45, 2Sa.20.20, al.; ἵ. εἶναι, סָלַח, 3Ki.8.30 ff. Jer.31.34, al. ;] 
propitious, merciful: τ. ἀδικίαες, Heb.8.12 (Je, l.with; cf.1 Ki, l.with); ἵ. σοι (sc. ἔστω ὁ θεός), Mat.16.22 (cf. 1Sam, l.with).†
(AS)

Ἰλλυρικόν, -οῦ, τό 
Illyricum, a region bordering on the Adriatic Sea: Rom.15.19.†
(AS)

ἱμάς, -άντος, ὁ 
[in LXX: Isa.5.27 (שְׂרוֹךְ), Sir.33.26, 4Ma.9.11, al ;] 
a thong, strap: for binding prisoners (Ma, Sir, ll. with), Act.22.25 for fastening sandals, Mk, Luk.3.16, Jhn.1.27.†
(AS)

ἱματίζω
(ἱμάτιον), 
to clothe: Mrk.5.15, Luk.8.35 (elsewhere only in π.; cf. MM, Exp., xv; Deiss., LAE, 78 f.).†
(AS)
